methodology_notes: All 90 runs executed live against 130 deterministic Apex Global artifacts (60,089 spreadsheet rows across 12 multi-tab .xlsx workbooks, 8 long-form .docx/.pdf compendiums, 22,200 analytical table rows, and live workspace/tracker connectors) using identical unguided prompts.

Strict skill-registry isolation was enforced on Frontier Reasoning Tier (gemini-4-argon) after initial trajectory inspection caught gemini-4-argon autonomously searching and installing mounted plugin skills from shared project skill registries on 5 of 12 non-plugin runs; contaminated runs were excluded and re-executed with empty non-arm registries.

Symmetric 300s judge read timeout was applied to the 18 runs originally affected by transient 120s Signal-2 evaluation timeouts; frozen v1.0 rubric verdicts are preserved without retroactive score editing.
